create_local_elastic_agent: create a LocalElasticAgent instance with a WorkerSpec to spawn local worker processes for distributed training
run_local_elastic_agent: run a LocalElasticAgent to start, monitor, and stop worker processes as a single unit
setup_local_watchdog: setup a file-based watchdog timer server for monitoring worker process health via named pipe
start_local_workers: start worker processes with distributed environment variables and argument substitution for each local rank
monitor_local_workers: monitor worker processes by comparing expected PIDs against actual PIDs and returning run results
